summary.text: CERTEGO AS is a private limited company registered in Bergen, founded 1996-12-02. CERTEGO AS yter tjenester og driver handel innen låser, beslag og låssikkerhet og tilgrensende bransjer, samt alt som dermed er forbundet, herunder å delta i andre økonomiske anliggender. It was previously named LÅSGRUPPEN AS until 2015-03-25. Its main industry code is 46.840: wholesale of hardware, plumbing and heating equipment and supplies. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 661 966 526 NOK and the annual result was 24 851 234 NOK; operating income was down from 676 353 470 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 29 896 335 NOK in 2024 to 24 851 234 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 63 837 457 NOK in 2024 to 68 688 691 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is certego.no, which links to its Facebook, LinkedIn profiles. Its website links to a careers page or job board. The latest news on its own website is "CERTEGO hjelper tre norske kommuner med å forenkle driften og videreutvikle sikkerheten" from 2026-11-03. The registered employee count went from 311 on 2025-11-13 to 305 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-11-06 (naeringskode3).
